newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's AGF says to raise coffee wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Japan's AGF says to raise coffee wholesale prices.

text.p: Japan's Ajinomoto General Foods Inc (AGF) said on Tuesday it would raise its wholesale coffee price by about 10 percent from May 1, reflecting the global coffee market's rally and the yen's decline since early this year.
The coffee roaster said in a statement that the recent rally in coffee prices was greater than expected and bullish sentiment was likely to continue.
AGF, a joint venture between Japan's Ajinomoto Co and Philip Morris Cos Inc's Kraft Foods International Inc, is one of Japan's leading coffee roasters.
The company did not disclose its wholesale coffee prices, although it said the price increase would raise retail prices by nearly 35 yen per 100 grams.
